resources.string: Gesture trainer

Choose a group of gestures. Each exercise describes a gesture. Make the gesture %1$d times; the result of each try is spoken. After the last try, the screen lists the measurements of each try, what to change and related settings.

Put the index and middle finger next to each other, and the thumb and ring finger a few centimetres away on either side. Then bring all four fingertips together to one point.
